title: feat(jest): a repo seam for jest cuts, globalSetup, retries; fail on stale patches
description:
## .what
declapract-typescript-ehmpathy 0.50.0 checks the jest configs, the integration + acceptance env files, the prepare files, and `src/.test/use*.ts` as EQUALS. a consumer repo has no seam for its own jest needs. rhachet-roles-bhrain lost these on upgrade:

- a `.log/` haste cut (`modulePathIgnorePatterns`): stray `.snap` files under `.log/` read as obsolete
- `.behavior/` + `.scratch/` cuts: records of retired code load as suites
- a repo globalSetup hook: no place for a once-per-run step (bhrain picks a brain tier there)
- a way to run `.agent/repo=.this/` skill suites: `testPathIgnorePatterns` cuts all of `/.agent/`
- `jest.retryTimes(2)` and a 240s timeout for live-brain acceptance; the acceptance pool is now `--runInBand` (from `tests-any/best-practice/package.json`)

## .the near seam, already shipped
`tests-node/best-practice/jest.integration.env.ts.declapract.ts` checks `contents === declared base + usecase inserts` via `defineExpectedContentsWithUsecaseInserts`. the insert mechanism exists; only a practice (persist-with-dynamodb) may declare an insert. to open it to a repo-declared insert may be the smallest cure.

## .stale patches
`allowUnusedPatches` + `ignorePatchFailures` let a patch keyed `test-fns@1.15.7` go stale after a bump to 1.17.0 with no signal, though its fix was still owed (only a clamp test caught it). worse, the stale-patch retire (`pnpm/stale-patched-dependency`) drops the key AND deletes the patch file, so a second apply would have removed the fix from the repo. upstream fulcrum F55 named this failhide at 60%.

## .ask
- a repo-owned extension seam (open the usecase-insert seam to the repo, or a `jest.*.config.repo.ts` merged in) so a consumer keeps its cuts without a full override
- when a patch goes stale because its dep was bumped (not removed): say so loud at upgrade and name the rekey (`patches/<pkg>@<new>.patch`), never delete the file

first seen in rhachet-roles-bhrain `.route/v2026_11_19.declapract.upgrade`, stones 3.1 (fulcrum F5) and 3.2 (D3, D4, D7).
